source_text: Servivit Baalim et dereliquerunt Dominum Deum patrum. Reliquiae secundum electionem gratiae salvae. Baal — idolum cupiditatis.
pass_a_gloss: Served Baals and abandoned Lord God of-fathers. Remnant according-to election of-grace saved. Baal — idol of-desire.
